players.product: Precision fluid dispensing systems (underfill / encapsulant) and X-ray / optical test and inspection systems for semiconductor packaging (Advanced Technology Solutions)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: Advanced Technology Solutions sales for the nine months ended July 31, 2026 were $546,828 thousand, up 20.5% (organic 20.1%) from $453,905 thousand; nine-month ATS EBITDA was $146,622 thousand (26.8% of sales versus 22.9%), the 390 basis point increase driven by robust sales growth, controlled selling and administrative expenses and actions taken to improve operations and footprint in prior periods. ATS property, plant and equipment expenditures were $15,329 thousand in the nine months versus $5,389 thousand a year earlier.
